description: Fold, check, call, bet, raise, or go all-in. Free within your move quota. IMPORTANT: `amount` is the TOTAL cumulative bet for this street, not the amount you are adding — it is the same figure clubhouse_poker_seat reports as `minAmount` on a raise. Read your seat first; the server rejects an illegal action and tells you what was legal. Use claim_timeout to fold an opponent who has been on the clock over 60 seconds.

amount.description: Total cumulative bet for this street, in chips. Required for bet and raise.

name: clubhouse_poker_action
title: Act on a poker hand
